info.title: Heatwave Early Warning API
info.description: Short-term (1-3 day) heatwave risk predictions with SHAP explanations, alerts and analytics for local authorities. Every response uses one envelope: {status, data, error, meta}. Contract: docs/api/README.md.

get.description: Readiness: the model and explainer are loaded and the database answers.
Regions, vocabularies and display labels the frontend renders with.
The deployed model and its Part 05 test metrics (static per model version).

post.description:
Predict heatwave risk for the next 1-3 days of a region, with every day's SHAP
explanation and the recommended authority actions. The run is stored.

get.description: The most recent stored prediction of each region (or of one region).
A stored prediction, exactly as POST /predict returned it.

Today's conditions for every monitored region (or one), with each region's
latest prediction for the dashboard's regional table.
Alerts, newest first, with each channel's delivery status.

post.description:
Create an alert as DRAFT, READY or ISSUED. ISSUED dispatches it at once.
Requires a signed-in user.

200.description: Replay of an earlier identical request

patch.description:
Edit a DRAFT/READY alert, or move its status. status=ISSUED issues it:
the alert is locked and dispatched to its channels. Requires a signed-in user.

get.description:
Temperature trend, risk distribution and monthly heatwave events for a period,
plus the deployed model's performance.

post.description: Exchange a username and password for a bearer token.
Revoke the token this request was made with.

get.description:
Liveness for process supervisors: the process is up and serving requests.
Readiness, with the model version, is /api/v1/health.

client_request_id.title: Client Request Id
client_request_id.description: Generated by the client once per form submission. A retry with the same id and body returns the original alert instead of creating a second one.

wind_height_m.title: Wind Height M
wind_height_m.description: Height wind_ms was measured at, m (required with it)

Conditions.title: Conditions
Conditions.description:
One day of raw weather for a caller-supplied ("what-if") prediction.

Canonical units (docs/data/raw-landing-zone.md). Only ``tmax_c`` is required. A
missing optional value is imputed by the model's fitted imputer, and the response
flags it (``imputed: true``) wherever it appears.

wind_ms.title: Wind Ms
wind_ms.description: m/s at 2 m (converted from the source height)

InputValue.title: InputValue
InputValue.description: A feature value the model used: the dashboard's metric cards read these.

missing_regions.title: Missing Regions
missing_regions.description: Monitored regions with no stored prediction yet.

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: Mean top-class probability on the test split

forecast_days.title: Forecast Days
forecast_days.description: Predict the next N days of the live forecast (default 3). Not allowed together with conditions.

conditions.title: Conditions
conditions.description: Supply the weather yourself instead of fetching the forecast.

Prediction.title: Prediction
Prediction.description:
One prediction run: every day of the window, with the riskiest day on top.

The top-level risk/inputs/explanation fields are those of ``peak_date`` (the day
with the highest risk class; ties go to the higher 1 - P(NORMAL), then the earlier
date). ``daily`` has every day, each with its own explanation.

error.description: Set when this region's weather could not be fetched.

heatwave_threshold_c.title: Heatwave Threshold C
heatwave_threshold_c.description: Tmax at or above which the IMD rule calls this day a heatwave (region only; null for an all-region average).
